ActionDescriptions.ToCreateAutomatonSkill:
to create a recurring stateful agent loop
Loads the standard workflow for designing or creating an Automaton: a recurring, stateful, evidence-driven agent loop with durable state, bounded worker assignments, verification, and clean stop/resume behavior.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateDllBackedCapabilityFromScratchSk:
to create a csharp dll backed skill from scratch
Loads the trusted workflow for creating new C# code capability first, with stable API and passing tests, before ProtoScript installation.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateSubjectMatterExpertResearchBrief:
to mine prior session history for a topic brief
Loads the standard workflow for creating an evidence-first SME research brief from ontology anchors, topic expansion, local session-message searches, source-linked evidence, workstreams, conclusions, operational guidance, risks, and open questions.
ActionDescriptions.ToCritiqueAgentSessionInteractionSkill:
to inspect a failed turn and recommend improvements
Loads the trusted workflow for offline critique of a session, turn, or session region by inspecting tool calls, arguments, results, artifacts, logs, and better-route opportunities.
ActionDescriptions.ToDesignBuffalyResultTypeRendererSkill:
to add a custom result renderer to the buffaly timeline
Loads shared Buffaly guidance for returning structured UI results with metadata.result_type/result_payload and rendering them through the timeline result-type handler pipeline.
ActionDescriptions.ToDesignProtoScriptPreviewGridSkill:
to build a buffaly preview grid result type
Loads shared Buffaly guidance for combining result_type metadata, RunProtoScriptMethodAsync, returned JSON text, and JavaScript table rendering into a reusable preview-grid flow.

to expose csharp class methods as protoscript actions
Loads the canonical workflow for exposing an existing C# class to ProtoScript using thin class-based wrapper files with preserved native return types and no ProtoScript-side business logic.
ActionDescriptions.ToImproveCodeQualityAndReduceRedundancyS:
to simplify and deduplicate csharp ui and protoscript paths
Loads the trusted workflow for reducing code bloat by enforcing canonical contracts, deleting compatibility branches, and simplifying C#/UI/ProtoScript paths.
ActionDescriptions.ToImproveOntologyQualityAndOrganizationS:
to improve protoscript ontology structure
Loads a trusted workflow for improving ontology structure, inheritance quality, and file organization, including removing redundant parents and placing instances under appropriate parents/files.
ActionDescriptions.ToInstallExistingDllIntoProtoScriptSkill:
to integrate an existing dll backed capability into opsagent
Loads the trusted workflow for integrating an already-built and tested DLL-backed capability into OpsAgent/ProtoScript.
ActionDescriptions.ToReturnProtoScriptPreviewGridResult:
to render sample protoscript preview grid
Return a structured Buffaly result envelope for rendering a ProtoScript-backed preview grid. sessionKey - target session key for the live ProtoScript runtime. prototypeName - ProtoScript prototype to call. args - JsonObject of named method parameters. methodName - method to call, default Preview. title - visible card title.
ResponseResultType: ProtoScriptPreviewGrid.
ResponseDirectiveContract: mirror tool envelope fields exactly into assistant message metadata (format/result_type) and content text.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunModelQuorumWorkflowSkill:
to create a quorum of models and score their outputs
Loads the standard workflow for running a model quorum: create or reuse multiple child sessions with user-selected or agent-selected models, dispatch the same task without waiting, collect durable markdown artifacts, then score, compare, or synthesize the results.
ActionDescriptions.ToTroubleshootBuffalyAgentRuntimeSkill:
to run buffaly agent troubleshooting workflow

ActionDescriptions.ToTroubleshootProtoScriptDllCompilationS:
to isolate dll loading issues with a local harness
Loads the trusted workflow for diagnosing ProtoScript DLL/type/method binding failures (missing types, missing methods, stale skill-local DLLs, import/reference mismatches) and applying a deterministic fix sequence.
